title: Asymptotic analysis of Rayleigh-Lamb dispersion relations under various boundary conditions
summary: We investigate the asymptotic behavior of the complex roots of Rayleigh-Lamb dispersion relations arising in elastic waveguides. We consider Neumann, Dirichlet, and fluid boundary conditions and derive explicit asymptotic expansions of the associated wavenumbers as their modulus tends to infinity. In the Neumann case, we provide a rigorous justification of asymptotic formulas that have long been used in the literature without proof, together with higher-order terms and explicit constants.
